notes: PleaIMD (PLEA) is an ERC-20 with 18 decimals and a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens. Its parameterless constructor mints the entire supply once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no admin roles, external mint or burn functions, or transfer fees. No application contracts are deployed. The pool pairs PLEA with IMD at a 1.25% fee. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
